# gigamon_app_viz (Resource)

Manages an App Viz application instance on a monitoring session.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) Alias for the App Viz application.
- `monitoring_session_id` (String) The ID of the monitoring session to associate this app with

### Optional

- `action` (Boolean) Enable or disable action for App Viz.
- `description` (String) Description for the App Viz application.
- `exporter_config` (Attributes) Exporter configuration for App Viz. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--exporter_config))
- `mgmt_interface` (String) Management interface used by App Viz. Valid values: internal, external.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the App Viz app resource

<a id="nestedatt--exporter_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `exporter_config`

Optional:

- `monitor` (Attributes) Monitor-specific export behavior. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--exporter_config--monitor))

<a id="nestedatt--exporter_config--monitor"></a>
### Nested Schema for `exporter_config.monitor`

Optional:

- `timeout` (Number) Monitor timeout in seconds.
